title: CSBG Tribal Annual Report
description: CSBG Tribal Annual Report - Complete Form

sections.title: Module 1: Tribal Administration
sections.description: Section A: CSBG Lead Tribal Agency, CSBG Authorized Official, CSBG Point of Contact
sections.instructional_note: The reporting timeframes for all information in the tribe or tribal organization's administration module is based on the FEDERAL FISCAL YEAR, which runs from October 1 of a given calendar year until September 30 of the following calendar year.
sections.help_text: A.1. Provide the following information in relation to the tribe or tribal organization designated to administer CSBG as required in Sections 676 and 677 of the CSBG Act, the Human Services Reauthorization Act of 1998 (P.L.105-285), and relevant federal policy guidance. The following information should mirror the information provided on the Application for Federal Assistance, SF-424M.

fields.name: tribe_name
fields.label: A.1a. Name of Tribe or Tribal Organization
fields.help_text: Information should mirror the SF-424M Application for Federal Assistance

fields.name: contact_person_name
fields.label: A.1b. CSBG Program Contact Person - Name

fields.name: contact_person_title
fields.label: A.1b. CSBG Program Contact Person - Title

fields.name: contact_work_phone
fields.label: A.1c. Work Telephone number and Extension (if applicable)

sections.title: Module 2: Tribal CSBG Expenditures
sections.instructional_note: Section A: CSBG Tribal Expenditures Form meets the Congressional requirement for an explanation of the total amount of CSBG funding expended during the reporting period (identified below) based on categories referenced in the CSBG Act. CSBG funding expended during federal fiscal year should be identified in the domain that best reflects the services delivered and strategies implemented, as well as the administrative costs associated with the domains. Note: The reporting timeframes for all information in the tribal expenditures module is based on the FEDERAL FISCAL YEAR, which runs from October 1 of a given calendar year until September 30 of the following calendar year.

fields.name: expenditure_childcare_education
fields.label: A.2b. Childcare, Early Childhood, Youth Development, and Adult Education

fields.name: expenditure_civic_engagement
fields.label: A.2f. Civic Engagement and Community Involvement

fields.name: expenditure_total
fields.label: A.2j. Total CSBG Expenditures
fields.help_text: Auto-calculated sum of A.2a through A.2i

sections.title: Module 3: Individual and Family
sections.instructional_note: Section A: Individual and Family Services Data Entry Form provides information on the work CSBG Tribal Agencies did to serve individuals and families. This standardized Individual and Family Services list will aid in analysis of the relationship between people, services, and outcomes.

fields.name: srv1_employment
fields.label: SRV 1: Employment Services
fields.help_text: Describe all employment related services, such as support for job placement, vocational and skills training, job development, and eliminating barriers to work. (If you did not provide this service, indicate "N/A" for not applicable.)

fields.name: srv2_childcare_education
fields.label: SRV 2: Childcare, Early Childhood, Youth Development, and Adult Education Services
fields.help_text: Describe all education related services, such as adult education, literacy programs, scholarships, Head Start enhancement, child development programs, and anti-drug education. Additionally, describe all youth development related activities. (If you did not provide this service, indicate "N/A" for not applicable.)

fields.name: srv3_income_asset
fields.label: SRV 3: Income and Asset Building Services
fields.help_text: Describe all income management and asset building related services, such as budgeting assistance, tax preparation, tax credit education, medical benefits, claims assistance, and savings programs. (If you did not provide this service, indicate "N/A" for not applicable.)
